checkpoints.description: [1/4] Verify the last five pushes, fix the menu click-through, sharpen licensing and count copy, add manifest identity and a CI test gate

impact_assessment.why: Visual and behavioural review of the last five pushes found a real menu defect: taps on the dimmed scrim activate the hero CTA underneath; keyboard focus can also leave the open menu. The site also overstates that all commercial use needs ACL-1.0 while most published repositories still carry AGPL-3.0, and it calls 33 project repositories simply 'repositories'.
impact_assessment.benefits: Taps on the scrim close the menu instead of navigating; background content is inert while the menu is open; licensing copy matches the AGPL-to-Aegean transition; manifest carries a stable identity; CI runs the regression suite on every push.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no public URL or asset path changes; dependency: none, stdlib and GitHub Actions only; concurrency: inert is toggled only by setNav; state: no ledger or certificate schema changes; visual: scrim opacity changes slightly.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Cover every change with regression tests, re-run Playwright at 1440/834/390/320 with JS blocked and enabled, run aikit.py check, and verify the live page after push.

checkpoints.description: Task 'site-v8' completed successfully.
[1/2] Follow-up audit: structured data, filter labelling, accurate license CTA and menu link closing

impact_assessment.why: The post-push review found that the brand link left the mobile menu open, the three-license card linked only AL-1.1, filter chips did not name the grid they control, and the page lacked machine-readable organization data.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every header link closes the menu, the licensing CTA matches the card, filters announce their target, and crawlers can identify the studio, its profiles and publisher relationship.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no URL or path changes; dependency: none; concurrency: header and nav listeners both call setNav(false), which is idempotent; state: no schema changes; policy: JSON-LD identifiers are not loaded resources, documented with a hygiene marker.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Regression tests cover the header-close wiring, JSON-LD parsing, chip controls and README atlas completeness; verify with Playwright and axe at desktop and mobile widths.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Implemented and verified: header links close the menu, CTA points at the catalog, chips expose aria-controls, JSON-LD describes the studio, README atlas completeness is asserted. checklists: passed

checkpoints.description: Task 'site-v9' completed successfully.
[1/2] Print legibility: reveal all content and keep the dark palette when the page is printed

impact_assessment.why: Reveal elements start at opacity 0 and the dark palette prints as light text on a white sheet when browsers drop backgrounds, so a printed licensing section or portfolio could be blank.
impact_assessment.benefits: Printed and PDF copies include every revealed section, keep the intended contrast and drop the sticky header, filters and decorative layers.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no screen rendering changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no persisted state changes; policy: print colors are forced exact for legibility
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test the print media query, verify computed opacity is 1, produce a PDF, and re-run the full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Print media reveals all content, keeps exact colors, and drops interactive chrome; 45 tests and 4/4 gates pass. checklists: passed

checkpoints.description: Task 'site-v10' completed successfully.
[1/2] Make the umbrella licensing copy true for every repository, including AGPL, Apache-2.0, MIT and unlicensed outliers

impact_assessment.why: GitHub reports 34 public repositories; most carry AGPL-3.0 or a custom Aegean license, N1-Engine is Apache-2.0, NeurologyClinicTemplates-TR is MIT, and PNN has no LICENSE at all. A blanket claim that current releases use the Aegean family is false for those repositories.
impact_assessment.benefits: The licensing section and README describe the family, the per-repository variation and the AGPL history without overclaiming; visitors know the LICENSE in each repository is authoritative.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no URL or asset changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no schema or certificate changes; content: the section no longer claims all projects are source-available
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin the new wording in tests, keep the tier links and CTA, and re-run gates plus a live copy check.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Umbrella licensing copy now names the family, the AGPL/Apache/MIT outliers and the repository LICENSE as authoritative; 45 tests and 4/4 gates pass. checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit, close the task and push, then verify the live licensing section

checkpoints.description: Task 'site-v11' completed successfully.
[1/4] Add a public browser verifier for format-2 certificates and sync the GitHub titles, topics and descriptions

impact_assessment.why: The owner wants a license-verification surface on the public site and the newly updated GitHub repository metadata reflected in the portfolio. The audit must prove that publishing a verifier cannot expose signing material or permit a forged certificate.
impact_assessment.benefits: Visitors can check a certificate against the canonical public register without sending it anywhere; every project card and README entry uses the updated GitHub title, topic tags and description; the verifier follows ACL-1.0 Section 6 instead of inventing a second trust model.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new verify.html URL, no existing URL changes; dependency: browser Web Crypto only, Node only for tests; concurrency: no shared state; state: no certificate, register or key changes; security: untrusted certificate JSON must never be rendered as HTML or checked with a key
impact_assessment.mitigation: Fetch only the canonical register and frozen terms over HTTPS, require a register entry, use textContent and size limits, add Node parity tests against a Python-generated conformance vector, and scan the site for signing material.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Public verifier, fail-closed form, metadata sync, CI Node gate, ADRs and tests are in place; 64 Python tests, 39 Node assertions and 4/4 gates pass. checklists: passed

handoff.state: end-to-end issue/valid/tampered/revoke passes with zero non-GET requests, axe reports no WCAG violations, and the GitHub metadata snapshot matches the API
handoff.next: commit, close the task and push, then verify the live verify page against the real register

checkpoints.description: Task 'site-v12' completed successfully.
[1/2] Fail the verifier button closed until the canonical register is ready

impact_assessment.why: The submit button was enabled before verify.js loaded, and a click during the initial fetch hit a false 'verification unavailable' error because loadRegistries returned early while loading.
impact_assessment.benefits: The primary action is disabled until the register and terms are parsed, becomes enabled exactly when the page is ready, and stays disabled with a working Refresh retry when the registry is offline.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no URL or fetch changes; dependency: none; concurrency: one in-flight load still guarded; state: no persisted state; accessibility: a disabled primary action is announced consistently
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static tests assert the disabled attribute and both transitions; Playwright verifies enabled-after-load and disabled-on-offline; axe remains clean at both widths.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Button fail-closed until ready; ready and offline states verified; 64 tests, 39 Node assertions and 4/4 gates pass. checklists: passed
